articles.summary: One complete response and three partial responses observed in heavily pretreated ICI-secondary refractory patients in high dose cohorts Deep and durable ongoing responses with median time on treatment of 15 months Company to accelerate development of PLN-101095 with initiation of a Phase 1b
articles.title: Pliant Therapeutics Announces Interim Data from PLN-101095 in Patients with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Refractory Advanced Solid Tumors
